about: Invented. What Stage 1 returns as an entity whose name no turn of the conversation says, by the kind of source. Each story is one conversation; `kind` is how it reaches Sleep: chat (an exported AI chat), session (a harness session), agent_note (a note an agent saved), memory_note (an agent's memory file), messages (a ticked chat with a person). `facts` are regexes of what the conversation says that must still be held somewhere after Sleep (a page, a claim, a held line); `named` is what the conversation itself names.

stories.title: Shelf camera and first screens
turns: I've been building Lanternbook, my recipe app. The bit I'm stuck on is where you point the camera at your pantry shelf and it works out what you have. It misreads jars about 30 percent of the time. Also the first thing people see after install is way too long, I want it down to three steps.
For the camera part, a cheaper first step might be letting people confirm each guess. For the first screens, cut anything that is not asking for a permission.
Good idea on confirming. I'll try that on Friday and keep the three steps.

stories.title: Pronostico de olas
turns: Estoy construyendo Mareviva, una app para surfistas. La parte que me da problemas es la pantalla donde se ve la semana de olas de cada playa; tarda ocho segundos en cargar. Y quiero que el aviso de marea baja llegue una hora antes.
Puedes guardar en cache la semana y refrescar solo el dia de hoy. Para el aviso, programa la notificacion local.
Perfecto, lo hago el lunes con el cache.

stories.title: Rechnungen hochladen
turns: Ich arbeite an Brunnwerk, einer App fuer kleine Handwerksbetriebe. Der Teil, wo Kunden ihre Rechnungen als Foto hochladen, verliert bei schlechtem Netz die Bilder. Ausserdem moechte ich, dass die Mahnung nach vierzehn Tagen automatisch rausgeht.
Lege die Fotos zuerst lokal ab und lade sie im Hintergrund hoch. Die Mahnung kannst du mit einem taeglichen Job loesen.
Ja, lokal zwischenspeichern ist der Weg. Die Mahnung baue ich naechste Woche.

stories.title: Le carnet de jardin
turns: Je developpe Potagerie, un carnet de jardinage. Ce qui me bloque, c'est l'ecran ou on voit le calendrier des semis: il affiche les mauvais mois dans l'hemisphere sud. Je veux aussi que le rappel d'arrosage soit propose seulement s'il n'a pas plu.
Il faut stocker l'hemisphere dans le profil et decaler les mois. Pour l'arrosage, consulte la meteo locale.
D'accord, je commence par l'hemisphere.

stories.title: Gravacao de exercicios
turns: Estou a desenvolver o Cantilena, uma app para professores de musica. A parte em que o aluno grava o exercicio e o professor ouve depois ainda corta o fim da gravacao. Quero tambem um resumo semanal por email com os progressos.
Verifica o buffer ao parar a gravacao. O resumo pode ser um job semanal.
Vou testar o buffer amanha.

stories.title: Exporter work
turns: Continue with the Lanternbook exporter, the uploads keep failing on weak wifi.

Done. I added retry with backoff to the upload worker, fixed the flaky timezone test in the exporter, renamed the nightly digest job so it no longer clashes with the weekly one, and opened PR #412 making shelf scan results cacheable. Tests pass locally.
Good, merge the retry one first.

stories.title: Trabajo en Mareviva
turns: Sigue con Mareviva, la lista de playas favoritas se pierde al cerrar la app.

Listo. Guarde las favoritas en el almacenamiento local, arregle el orden de las mareas en la pantalla semanal y agregue una prueba para el aviso de marea baja. Abri el PR #77 que mueve el cache a un archivo aparte.
Perfecto, junta primero lo de las favoritas.

stories.title: Quillgrove editor
turns: In Quillgrove, make the chapters draggable and stop autosave from overwriting a newer draft.

Implemented the chapter reorder handle, wired autosave to the draft store with a version check, added the word-count badge to the sidebar, and removed the old export dialog. PR #190 covers the reorder, PR #191 the autosave guard.
Nice. Ship the autosave guard today.

stories.title: Session notes
stories.body: Session notes for Lanternbook. PR #418 Add CSV export of the pantry list. PR #419 Fix crash when the shelf scan returns nothing. PR #421 Weekly digest PDF layout. Decision: the person chose SQLite over a hosted database for offline storage. Open: the install walkthrough is still seven steps.

stories.title: Sitzungsnotiz
stories.body: Notiz zu Brunnwerk. PR #55 Foto-Upload mit lokaler Warteschlange. PR #56 Mahnung nach vierzehn Tagen. Entscheidung: Die Person nimmt Postgres statt einer Dateidatenbank. Offen: Die Rechnungsvorschau ist zu langsam.

stories.title: Lanternbook status
stories.body: Lanternbook is in private beta with 12 testers. The offline sync design uses a per-device change log; the person rejected a CRDT library as too heavy. The release checklist lives in the team wiki and the camera work is the biggest risk.

stories.title: Etat de Potagerie
stories.body: Potagerie est en test avec huit jardiniers. La personne a choisi un calendrier des semis stocke localement plutot qu'un service distant. Le rappel d'arrosage dependra de la meteo; le choix du fournisseur est ouvert.

stories.title: Chat with Ilse
turns: how is the app going
slow. the scanning part is a mess but the beta people love the recipes page
ha. are you launching before the summer?
i want to, but the signup flow needs a rewrite first and that is two weeks of work

stories.title: Chat con Ines
turns: como va lo de las olas
bien, ya funciona el aviso pero la carga de la semana sigue lenta
y lo de publicar?
en abril, si arreglo la carga de la semana y el registro

stories.title: A letter to the council
turns: I need to write the long email to the council about the bike lane on Alder Street, and I also owe my landlord the monthly meter reading. Can you help me draft the first one?
Sure. Start with the problem: the lane ends at the junction. Then ask for a date of review.
Good. I'll send it Monday and keep the meter reading for the first of the month.

stories.title: Priya's newsletter
turns: My friend Priya Raman runs a newsletter and asked me about the sponsor section. She wants a cleaner way to show which sponsor paid for which issue, and a cap of two sponsors per issue.
A table at the bottom works. The cap can live in the template.
I'll tell her about the table.

stories.title: Mi proyecto de grado
turns: Estoy escribiendo mi proyecto de fin de grado sobre energia eolica marina y tengo que entregar el capitulo de metodos el 15 de marzo. Mi tutora quiere ver primero el plan de muestreo.
Empieza con el plan de muestreo y envialo antes del capitulo.
Lo envio el viernes.

stories.title: Everything named
turns: Lanternbook tracks its tasks in Linear and the notes in Notion. Sofia Marchetti does the design and I want to ask her about the Lanternbook logo.
Ask her for two options and a monochrome version.
Will do.
